title: Worker Handoff Schema
description: Defines the handoff artifacts a Worker must produce upon completion. Validated by verify-worker-handoff.ps1.

agentId.description: Codex agent ID assigned at spawn.

filesCreated.description: Absolute or worktree-relative paths of all files created by this worker.

filesModified.description: Absolute or worktree-relative paths of all files modified by this worker.

exportsProvided.description: Function/class/type names exported by this worker's source files.

evidenceOutputs.description: Paths to evidence files produced (test results, typecheck output, build logs).

contractSatisfied.description: Worker self-attestation that the interface contract is satisfied. Verified by handoff verifier.

knownLimitations.description: Worker-declared limitations, edge cases not handled, or known issues.

mailboxMessageId.description: ID of the mailbox handoff message if agent-mailbox/ exists.

validationRules.filesCreatedMustMatchWorktree: All files in filesCreated must exist in the worktree directory.
validationRules.filesCreatedMustNotContainOutsidePaths: No file in filesCreated may be outside worktreePath.
validationRules.exportsMustMatchSource: All exports in exportsProvided must be extractable from source files in worktree.
validationRules.evidenceOutputsMustExist: All paths in evidenceOutputs must exist.
validationRules.contractSatisfiedMustBeTrue: contractSatisfied must be true for handoff to be accepted (self-attested, verified).
validationRules.limitationsMustBeDeclared: knownLimitations must be explicit (empty array = no limitations declared, acceptable).
